title: Tree Inventory Volunteer
description: Independently completed a survey of a north Bellevue segment to map and collect data on all trees in the 80ft public right of way over the course of several weekends in the summer. I improved my tree identification skills and came to appreciate the difficulties associated with horticultural plant ID due to non-native landscaping!
duties: Collects multiple data points including DBH, disease status, tree identification, and photos in assigned segment
Performs data QA post-survey to ensure accuracy
Communicates project mission with members of the public
